project_focus.grade_labels: observed, externally verified grader outcomes only
project_focus.negative_examples: retain 6-7 and hidden-defect cases for model error diagnostics

sources.claimed_images: more than 20000 images; do not infer paired specimen count
sources.label_semantics: expected PSA grade, NOT observed PSA outcome
sources.possible_approved_role: visual pretraining or unsupervised quality analysis after license review

sources.label_semantics: publisher grade claim; mixes PSA, CGC, BGS and ACE; decimal feature values are not independently verified subgrades
sources.license_or_training_permission: not verified; no dataset card displayed
sources.possible_approved_role: post-grade diagnostic examples after source, copyright, specimen and label audits
sources.not_approved_for: assumed paired and pre-purchase PSA ground truth

dataset_storage_policy: Keep large original files in ignored local cache, never check images or secrets into GitHub. Preserve hashes and source licenses.
owner_action: Obtain source permission or documented usable license; establish genuine grade outcomes and same-copy front/back photos. Do not claim 23156 training specimens.
model_promotion: Require specimen-disjoint blind holdout and era-specific grade metrics; never count after-training fitting as a successful backtest.
